items.summary: Memory-chip stocks Micron and SK Hynix fell Monday after Chinese rival CXMT rocketed in its IPO on the Shanghai Stock Exchange.

items.title: Sandisk and More Chip Stocks Hit China Roadblocks
items.summary: FEATURE  China threw up a couple of roadblocks for chips stocks Monday, forcing Sandisk ASML Holding and a host of others into the ditch. The obstacles: a massive Chinese IPO and a state-backed company’s mass production of chip-making machines.

items.title: CXMT, Sandisk, ASML, SpaceX, D-Wave Quantum, Workday, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: FEATURE  A chip stock slide weighed on the major indexes following reports that a state-backed Chinese company has begun mass producing chip-making machines. Those same semiconductor companies, and many artificial-intelligence names, also were under pressure Monday after Chinese memory chip maker ChangXin Memory Technologies ’(CXMT) massive trading debut.

items.title: Chinese IPO Rattles Chip Stocks
items.summary: The company topped  Industrial and Commercial Bank of China  to become the most valuable company listed in a mainland Chinese market.  ASML and  Advanced Micro Devices  fell 5.8% and 5.2%, respectively.  The Nasdaq Composite ended the day down 0.2%.

items.title: EXCLUSIVE: China Is Coming For SanDisk—But Not Yet For Micron’s Memory Crown (CORRECTED)
items.summary: Editor’s Note: This story has been corrected to remove an inaccurate company reference. (NASDAQ:MU), SK Hynix Inc. (NASDAQ:SKHY) and Samsung Electronics Co. Ltd. (NYSE:SSNLF) for years. China, however, is making rapid progress in commodity DRAM and NAND.
